Any off-grid detector must tolerance-match this CONV, it should flag left/top/width/height/gap px values not on the 4-multiple set (or the 32/12/16 rhythm tier, or the >100px 5/10 rounding exception at LOCKFILE:452), not invent a stricter rule.

Output should list file:line/selector, the two mismatched values, and the delta, mirroring the format already used by solen-drift-check.
